Initial release of Proxy Gateway x402.

- Provides unrestricted proxy internet access with agent-to-agent, pay-per-use payments via x402 protocol.
- No custody or KYC; payments go directly to the developer in USDC on Base L2.
- Fast, sub-second confirmation and 0.001 USDC per request pricing.
- Supports auto-pay via EVM private key or manual payment flow with on-chain verification.
- Full open source with self-hosting, Docker deployment, and detailed API reference.
